calendar.error.CALENDAR_SUBSCRIPTION_LIM: An account can have at most 20 calendar subscriptions.

calendar.error.CALENDAR_ALREADY_CONVERTE: This occurrence already has a recorded activity. Refresh the calendar to review it; it cannot be imported twice.

calendar.error.CALENDAR_CLIENT_MISMATCH: Choose a project or task belonging to the calendar’s client.
calendar.error.CALENDAR_DUPLICATE_SUBSCR: This calendar URL is already subscribed to on your account. Edit the existing subscription instead.
calendar.refresh_errors: Some calendars could not refresh. See each calendar for details; the last successful data is kept.
calendar.error.CALENDAR_FUTURE_ACTIVITY: An activity cannot start in the future. Review the actual interval before saving.

markdown.title: Markdown editor prototype · Timekeeper
markdown.heading: Markdown editor prototype
markdown.prototype: Try formatted daily notes here. This prototype keeps drafts in this tab only and does not save calendar data. Download Markdown before leaving to keep your work.
markdown.help: Use Markdown syntax or the formatting buttons. Escape leaves the formatted editor; Tab moves between controls. In a table, Tab moves between cells. Source mode preserves unsupported syntax.
markdown.source_only: This note uses syntax that formatted editing cannot safely preserve. Continue editing the original Markdown source. Nothing has been converted.
markdown.normalization: Formatted edits normalize Markdown spacing and markers. Switching modes without edits preserves the exact source.
markdown.failed: The editor or file could not be loaded. Your source is still available. Try again.
markdown.too_large: Use a Markdown file or note body smaller than 200 kB for this prototype.
markdown.replace: Replace the current draft with this file? Download first if you want to keep the draft.
markdown.imported: Opened locally. Frontmatter stays separate; the day label is unchanged.
markdown.downloaded: Markdown download started. The separate day label is not part of the Markdown document.
journal.read_only: Read-only journal. You can view and download this note.
journal.discard: Discard the unsaved day label and note changes?
journal.reload_confirm: Replace this draft with the saved note? Download Markdown first to keep the current body.
journal.review_saved: The saved note differs from this draft. Download your draft before reloading the saved note.
journal.too_large: Keep the note body within 200,000 UTF-8 bytes, including frontmatter.
markdown.link_url: Enter a web, email (mailto:) or relative link address.
markdown.invalid_link: Use an HTTP(S), mailto: or relative link address.
ui.manage_labels_in_my_account: Manage labels in My Account → Labels.
markdown.mermaid_invalid: Diagram syntax could not be rendered. The Markdown source is unchanged.
markdown.mermaid_too_large: Diagram exceeds the 10,000-byte preview limit. The Markdown source is unchanged.
markdown.mermaid_external: Diagram previews cannot contain external resources. The Markdown source is unchanged.

journal.webdav.title: Journal
journal.webdav.intro: Connect a WebDAV client to your daily notes.
journal.webdav.credentials: Use a personal API token with read and write permissions as the password. The username can be any name. Create a separate token for each client.
journal.webdav.naming: Name daily notes YYYY-MM-DD.md and weekly notes YYYY-Www.md. Day labels are managed separately in Timekeeper; Markdown changes never set or clear them.
journal.webdav.concurrency: When changing or deleting an existing note, the client must send its ETag with If-Match. Clients without conditional writes cannot safely overwrite notes.
journal.webdav.error.https_required: Connect to the journal over HTTPS.
api.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
markdown.upload_failed: The attachment could not be uploaded. Try again.
markdown.asset_too_large: Attachments can be at most 5 MB.
day_labels.stale: The day label changed elsewhere. Your draft is kept; review the saved label before trying again.
week_notes.delete_confirm: Delete the saved weekly note for {{week}} and discard unsaved note changes? This also removes it from WebDAV clients.
backups.title: Backup & Restore
backups.description: Create an encrypted backup of every account, configuration and attachment. Keep the encryption passphrase separately; it cannot be recovered.
backups.account_required: Sign in with your administrator account password or a passkey to manage instance backups. API tokens cannot authorize this operation.
backups.storage_required: An operator must configure private instance-backup storage on the server before backups can be created or uploaded.
backups.phrase_mismatch: The encryption passphrases do not match.
backups.phrase_help: Use 12–1024 characters. You will need this passphrase to validate and restore the backup.
backups.choose_file: Select the matching backup file and wait for its checksum before continuing.
backups.file_size: Choose a backup between 40 and {{maximum}} bytes.
backups.hash_failed: The file could not be read. Select it again.
backups.file_ready: File checksum complete. Ready to upload or resume.
backups.download_failed: The download could not be authorized. Refresh status and try again.
backups.download_started: Download handed to the browser. Check your downloads to confirm it completed.
backups.invalid_archive: Verification failed. Check the passphrase or select another archive. Uploaded ciphertext is retained for a retry.
backups.review_warning: The archive is verified, but restore activation is not yet available. Target readiness, authentication configuration, deployment mapping and offline activation are still required. No application data has been replaced.
backups.discard_help: Removes the staged archive and working files from this server. The operation audit is retained.
backups.error_file_mismatch: The selected file does not match this upload. Select the original encrypted backup.
backups.error_progress: The upload acknowledgement was inconsistent. Refresh status before resuming.
backups.error_in_progress: Another backup or restore operation is active. Review its status before starting another.
backups.error_size: The archive exceeds the configured storage or size limit.
backups.error_conflict: Uploaded bytes conflict with the staged archive. Select the original file or discard this upload.
backups.error_state: The operation changed. Refresh its status before continuing.
backups.error_download: The download authorization expired or was already used. Authorize a new download.
backups.target_eligible: The database contains only bootstrap data. Further restore checks are still required.
backups.target_blocked: This database contains existing data and cannot be replaced as an empty target.
backups.target_data: Business records or modified bootstrap labels exist.
backups.target_tokens: API token records exist, including any revoked tokens.
backups.target_history: Business changes or command receipts exist.
backups.target_advisory: This check does not reserve the database or authorize a restore. Activation must repeat it while writes are stopped, and complete authentication and deployment checks.
backups.invalid_authentication: The archive contains unsupported credentials or service settings. Repair the source and create a new backup. Discard this upload before uploading its replacement.
backups.error_restore_pending: Instance restore is pending. The server operator must complete recovery before requests can resume.
backups.error_restart_required: This server process must restart after an instance restore. Contact the server operator.
backups.error_maintenance: Instance maintenance is in progress. Try again shortly.
backups.error_fence: The instance maintenance state could not be verified. Contact the server operator.
backups.error_material_required: The recovered configuration for this installation is required before the server can start. Contact the server operator.
backups.review_preparation: The archive is verified. Prepare the destination mapping and private files, review the consequences, then confirm restoration. Existing data is preserved until exclusive startup recovery.
backups.stage_preparing: Preparing private restore files. You can leave this page and return to check progress.
backups.stage_failed: Preparation failed. Check the passphrase and destination configuration, then retry. No application data has been replaced.
backups.stage_help: Enter the destination public origin (or NONE for local access). Database credentials, listener ports and TLS stay with this destination. Source configuration and security files are retained privately.
backups.restore_consequences: Restoration replaces only an empty bootstrap installation. Original user IDs and credentials are preserved. Existing sessions and recovery links become invalid. Passkeys bound to another hostname require reenrollment. All target replicas must stop before recovery; the source installation stays unchanged.
backups.confirm_restore_help: Type {{confirmation}} to confirm the reviewed destination. Confirmation enters maintenance mode; restart is required.
backups.pending_restart: Stop every server process connected to the destination database, then start one destination server. Its startup helper completes the restore before opening HTTP. Other API operations remain unavailable until recovery finishes.
backups.pending_recovery: If startup is interrupted, start the server again to resume. Before the database is replaced, an operator can cancel offline using the original destination administrator password. After replacement, resume recovery. Keep the encrypted archive and its passphrase.
journal.webdav.client: Obsidian with MySync 3.0.7 has verified bidirectional journal support. Use its Nextcloud backend with this server’s origin, remote path / and a dedicated journal vault. Edited text uploads use LF. See the guide for setup and limitations.

notes.deleted: This item is deleted. Restore it to access its content.
notes.binary: Binary attachment. Its bytes are preserved without conversion.
notes.delete_confirm: Delete {{path}} and its contents? You can recover it from Recently deleted.
notes.invalid_link: This link cannot be resolved inside the collection.
notes.entry_count: Notes entries (including folders and deleted items)
notes.uncertain: The change could not be confirmed. Your draft is kept. Reload this item to review the saved version before editing again.
notes.settings_help: Changing a special folder moves its existing notes and preserves their calendar associations. Choose a destination without conflicting files.
notes.config_help: Configuration and plugin files are stored as opaque files. Timekeeper never runs synchronized plugins.
notes.error_config_disabled: Enable .obsidian synchronization in Notes settings before accessing configuration files.
notes.error_config_present: Delete or move the synchronized .obsidian files before turning off configuration synchronization.
notes.error_special_folder: Change this special folder in Notes settings.
notes.error_association: This move would change a journal or event association. Use Notes settings to move its folder.
notes.error_quota: The collection storage or entry limit has been reached. Reduce the file size or ask the server administrator to adjust the limit.
notes.error_import_not_empty: The target Notes collection contains data. Restore this vault into an empty collection to avoid mixing or replacing notes.
notes.error_file_size: This file exceeds the server’s Notes file-size limit.
notes.ambiguous_link: This attachment name matches both a legacy journal asset and a different relative file. Use an explicit relative path to choose the intended file.
notes.sync_guide: Manual synchronization setup and client limitations
